adaptation: Only the effort visual component, its matrix math, slider CSS, relevant motion keyframes and required tokens are adapted. The raw reference files are never loaded by the component.
Replace imperative buildElement rendering with React. Native input children remain caller-owned and are rendered last inside the visual track, without cloning, handlers or selection state.
Preserve the original 0.8 sinusoidal detent, rounded CSS-pixel travel, 16px knob width and +8px fill/tick centre geometry. One or no levels retain the original right-end rest.
Preserve the original five-row device-pixel matrix solver, integer hash, eight tone buckets, smoothstep plume mask and all three original per-cell timing formulas using the 1450ms flash token.

Scope copied selectors, custom properties and keyframe names to lpa-ce. Copy only required token values locally; inherit the same standard dsw host aliases with the same upstream color fallbacks. Read only a standard data-ds-dark-theme ancestor for the original dark apex palette and knob shadows.
Preserve the incoming and outgoing 150ms ease-in-out wording swap with 4px travel and 2px blur. Add a persistent polite live wrapper and hide the outgoing ghost from assistive technology.

Carry generated particle delay and duration through private CSS custom properties so the existing important animation precedence is preserved. The reduced choice mirrors the original theme/chrome.css net (D40) for durations and delays: they collapse to the 0.01ms reduced token, the flash shorthand keeps its important infinite so the apex twinkle keeps breathing, and matrix delays are cleared. One deliberate departure: the original net also compresses the apex flash itself to 0.01ms, which a display can only sample as a high-frequency strobe and which repaints every matrix square on every frame, so the reduced choice stops the per-square flash and breathes the whole matrix once at the 2400ms reduced period instead.

Measure only the owned track via ResizeObserver and window resize, clean up both, and place initial/changed geometry without a glide. Caller changes to index settle through the original 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1) transition; dragging removes travel easing.

Provide a fully transparent 16x30 native range overlay with identical 8px centre endpoints. Transfer focus paint to track :has(> .lpa-ce-input:focus-visible), preserving keyboard-only focus indication, restore the native input in forced colors, compress transitions/animations to the 0.01ms reduced net under prefers-reduced-motion — where the apex twinkle keeps breathing as one whole-matrix breath at the reduced period rather than the compressed one — and dim disabled controls without geometry changes.
No selection, permissions, network, profile, SDK or host-model calls are performed. Integration remains outside these new files. No font, logo, image, mascot or other asset files are copied or used.

interface.position: null uses the exact index stop; a non-null raw continuous 0..1 ratio is the knob-centre travel ratio and passes through magneticRatio. Set position to null with the final index on release for the original snap glide.
